shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying whole face
head or mask at the top with headdress-like element
carved relief bands across the torso
justification: Both are vertical monolithic slabs bearing a single frontal, bilaterally symmetrical anthropomorphic figure whose head-and-headdress fills the top, with a pectoral disc or ornament at the chest and banded relief below, resting on a low base. The manner of rendering differs sharply: A is a heavily worn, broad and shallow low relief with sparse simplified motifs, whereas B is drawn as a dense, deeply undercut, horror-vacui field of intricate scrollwork and subsidiary faces.
